verdict.rationale: Community reports indicate Brave publishes Terms of Use that define permitted use of results: the free tier prohibits using responses for AI inference, and a separate AI plan covers that use. This is a documented permitted-use stance, but the evidence is second-hand and the user found it ambiguous whether agent use counts as inference. missing for 10: any documented stance on robots.txt crawling compliance, any content licensing or redistribution terms for result content, first-party policy documentation in the pack, and clear guidance on what counts as AI inference.
